summary.intent: Execute all 4 plans in Phase 59 (FUSE IPNS Verify/Publish Hardening and Cleanup) using the GSD wave-based execution workflow, and separately investigate a staging DB quota discrepancy (441MB used on an empty vault/bin).
summary.outcome: Waves 1–3 (plans 59-01, 59-02, 59-03) completed and verified with 96 passing tests; Wave 4 (59-04) was still executing when the transcript ended. The quota investigation was initiated but not yet resolved.

repo: Root `npm test` runs `pnpm --parallel -r run test` (full monorepo) — starves RAM; post-merge gate must be scoped to `cargo test -p cipherbox-fuse` for Rust-only phases
CI does not run clippy at all; the plans' 'clippy -D warnings exits 0' acceptance criterion is aspirational, not enforced
23/43 (53%) of staging `folder_ipns` rows are legacy-unsigned (`signed_record IS NULL`), predating the Ed25519 signing convention that landed in #448 on 2026-04-04; oldest row is 2026-03-28
2 staging rows are 'partial': `signed_record` present but `public_key` NULL — treated by verify.rs as a potential downgrade vector, neither legacy nor modern
winfsp build is CI-only on macOS; winfsp and crypto clippy warnings are pre-existing and out-of-scope for this phase
Staging Postgres: container `cipherbox-staging-postgres-1`, user `cipherbox`, db `cipherbox_staging`, persistent volume (not reseeded between runs)
Phase 59 is a strict sequential 4-plan chain (59-01→02→03→04); worktree isolation provides no benefit and adds merge complexity for single-plan-per-wave phases

code.finding: Pre-existing complex type clippy warning (not introduced by phase 59)
Pre-existing too_many_arguments clippy warning; also a transient compile error site during the atomic VerifyError::Legacy enum migration in 59-02
Pre-existing Default impl clippy warning; also the primary file for 59-04 sequence unification (first-publish seq 0→1)
`signature_verified` field removal site (59-03 Finding E.1); caused transient compile errors during cleanup

workflow: GSD #2070 failure mode: executor writes SUMMARY.md but a 522 timeout hits before it can commit the file; rescue by staging and committing SUMMARY.md inside the worktree before running the merge/cleanup step
When a worktree subagent needs node_modules (e.g. for husky pre-commit hooks), it must run `pnpm i` to initialize its own copy — never symlink back to the parent checkout's node_modules
Sequential execution (no worktree) is the correct mode for strictly sequential single-plan waves: no merge step, no cleanup-wave, no symlink workarounds, no SUMMARY commit race
`docker exec -i` with stdin-piped SQL avoids nested shell quoting failures when running queries over SSH into a Docker container
`cargo clippy --no-deps` scopes lint output to the target crate only, filtering out pre-existing dependency warnings that would otherwise obscure phase-introduced issues

friction: Two separate Cloudflare 522 timeouts interrupted agent runs mid-execution; one hit after all code was committed but before SUMMARY.md was committed, requiring a manual rescue
`mktemp` reused a template name causing an empty `--manifest` variable in the cleanup-wave helper, requiring a retry with a fixed path
Worktree had an untracked `node_modules` symlink (created by subagent as a husky hook workaround) that blocked the pre-commit hook during merge; had to remove it manually before merge could proceed
Nested shell quoting failures when running SQL via SSH+docker exec; required switching to stdin-piped psql approach
The cleanup-wave tracking helper printed `commit_failed` despite the commit succeeding — a known false-negative that caused unnecessary concern
open_items: Wave 4 (59-04) still in-flight at transcript end: unify first-publish IPNS sequence from 0→1, remove verify.rs skew tolerance — this is the Phase 60 bridge change
Phase completion gates not yet run: TDD RED→GREEN sequence audit for 59-01/02, code review, full regression gate, phase-goal verifier
Staging quota discrepancy investigation unresolved: user pubkey 0x046d97... shows 441MB used with empty vault and bin — root cause unknown
2 partial-field staging rows (`signed_record` present, `public_key` NULL) are an intermediate state that falls outside both legacy and modern handling — worth tracking
Production legacy record ratio unknown; same `SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE signed_record IS NULL)` query on prod would give a complete picture
D.1 `publish_with_cas_retry` retains an unused `journal_entry` parameter with a TODO (D-01a) deferred from 59-03
24 pre-existing clippy warnings in cipherbox-fuse (structural, not phase regressions) left unresolved since clippy is not a CI gate
